verse: And in their mouth was found no guile: for they are without fault before the throne of God. Revelation 14:5.
title: The Seal of Transformation
bullets: Only those who bear the character of Christ receive God's seal—a mark that transforms the soul as wax receives the impression of a seal.
Many who claim to follow Jesus will face disappointment because they lack this seal; they live lukewarm lives that dishonor God far more than open unbelief.
As we behold Christ and fix our minds on Him alone, He is formed within us, and we are changed into His likeness and made ready for eternity.
prayer: Lord Jesus, help me fix my eyes on You alone and allow Your Spirit to reshape my character into Your image. Form Your likeness within me so that I may bear the seal of God and be counted among the faithful at last.
